enchantments.tooltip: Extra Smites 2: +2 Smite Evil uses per rest. Smite Evil uses regenerate 10% faster.
Sacred +7: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Sacred items provide an +7 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead.
Lesser Turning: Increases total number of Turn Undead uses by 2, once wielder rests. If you unequip the item you will lose these turns.
Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +7 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
